description.text: Financial management is a discipline that focuses on the movement of funds within an enterprise. Its core lies in addressing the issue of "how to efficiently raise, allocate, utilize, and monitor funds to maximize the enterprise's value". It not only considers "where the money comes from and where it is used", but also pays more attention to optimizing business decisions through fund management (such as "whether to expand by borrowing" and "whether to invest in new projects"). It is the "financial core" of enterprise operation. Unlike accounting, which focuses on "documenting the past", financial management is more focused on "planning for the future", serving as a bridge connecting financial data with business strategies.

duration.text: The Financial management at Xi'an Shiyou University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2569 USD/per year ￥ 18500 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Front page of the passport. 2. Highest educational qualification certificate. If the applicant is a student, a pre-graduation certificate or a student status certificate issued by the school where he/she is studying must be submitted. 3. Academic Transcript. The scanned copy of the transcript should include the highest academic stage and the grades up to the most recent semester. If it is in a language other than Chinese or English, a Chinese or English translation and notarization are required. 4. Recommendation Letters. Two recommendation letters, written in either Chinese or English. 5. Study Plan in China. The study plan should be written in either Chinese or English and must be no less than 300 words. 6. Other academic ability certificates or proof of participation in social activities. 7. Language proficiency certificates, such as HSK certificates, IELTS/TOEFL/ Duolingo test scores, or official English teaching certification. 8. "Foreigner Physical Examination Record Form". It should be filled out in Chinese or English. Download link: http://cie.xsyu.edu.cn/info/1066/2118.htm. 9. Certificate of No Criminal Record. If it is in a language other than Chinese or English, a Chinese/English translation and notarization must be provided as well.

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens, in good health. 2. Possess a high school diploma or equivalent educational qualification, and be between 18 and 24 years old. 3. Applicants for courses taught in Chinese must achieve a score of at least 180 on the New Chinese Proficiency Test (HSK Level 4). Applicants for courses taught in English must have an English proficiency score of 5.5 or above on the IELTS, or 69 or above on the TOEFL, or 90 or above on the PTE, or provide proof of English instruction for their highest degree (with the school's official seal).
